lead: Financial planning is often overwhelming and number-driven.
body: So we created an intuitive planning tool that helped people visualize their financial futures without a single number, using simple drag-and-drop life events to make complex decisions feel approachable and human. The site helped Lincoln win an Effie for its Futureself campaign.

modules.title: Things Change
modules.body: In the wake of a major market downturn, investor confidence was shaken. Our challenge was to reassure people that while their plans may have changed, Lincoln Financial Group would remain a steady guide, helping them navigate uncertainty, rebuild confidence, and stay on track toward their long-term goals.

modules.alt: Things Change animated banners in a web page
